messages.subject: [R-sig-Fedora] Cannot install igraph package
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

I am trying to install

igraph package

but getting the following error:

------------------
make: *** [/usr/lib64/R/etc/Makeconf:159: foreign-graphml.o] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package ?igraph?
* removing ?/usr/lib64/R/library/igraph?
------------------

Any ideas?

Thanks in advance,

Paul

   ret=fprintf(outstream, "         xsi:schemaLocation=\""
GRAPHML_NAMESPACE_URI "\n");

foreign-graphml.c:1414:38: error: expected ?)? before ?GRAPHML_NAMESPACE_URI?
   ret=fprintf(outstream, "         " GRAPHML_NAMESPACE_URI

library(devtools)
install_github("igraph/rigraph")

Please let us know if this works

Regards,

messages.subject: [R-sig-Fedora] greport on fedora
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am trying to run the greport package by Frank Harell on Fedora 26.
However, there are two software issues. Adobe Acrobat reader is
recommended, but Adobe does have a version for Linux anymore. The second
issue are the required ocgtools in the latex package, which are not
available. The links given on the home page of the package fail. Does
anybody use the package and do you have any recommendations in terms of
setup. It looks very useful for the reporting of clinical trials.

Any help would be very much appreciated.

Thank you

Andreas

	[[alternative HTML version deleted]]
